correctness.rationale: The injection ι:A=k[x,y,z]→k^Ω repeats each f over infinite fibers X×N; Zariski density plus infinitely repeated fibers imply ι(A)∩D=0. Each coordinate idempotent in finite-support ideal D is divisible in R by one of ι(x),ι(y),ι(z) because X excludes origin, so D⊆I. Since D²=D, expansion yields I^n=D+ι(m^n) for all n≥1. The quotient R/I^n≅A/m^n is compatible with multiplication, giving gr_I(R)≅k[x,y,z], I-adic completion k[[x,y,z]], and intersection/kernel exactly D by polynomial total-degree order. A finite-support idempotent e annihilator makes 1-e∉I invert all d∈D under localization, so R_I≅A_m.
